traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The chuul can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Sense Magic
traits.text: The chuul senses magic within 120 feet of itself. This trait otherwise works like the Detect Magic spell but isn’t itself magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The chuul makes two Pincer attacks and uses Paralyzing Tentacles.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of two pincers.
